config.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

config.label: Eurostat API base URL
config.description: Eurostat API base URL. Override when using a mirror or proxy.

config.label: HTTP request timeout in milliseconds for Eurostat API calls
config.description: HTTP request timeout in milliseconds for Eurostat API calls.

config.label: How long a fetched catalogue TOC stays usable before the next catalogue call refreshes it, in milliseconds
config.description: How long a fetched catalogue TOC stays usable before the next catalogue call refreshes it, in milliseconds. Defaults to 12 hours.

config.label: HTTP timeout for one eurostat_download_dataset transfer, in milliseconds
config.description: HTTP timeout for one eurostat_download_dataset transfer, in milliseconds. Held separate from EUROSTAT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS because a bulk body streams for minutes where a metadata call answers in seconds. Defaults to 2 minutes.

config.label: Byte budget for one eurostat_download_dataset transfer, counted on the decoded TSV rather than on the wire
config.description: Byte budget for one eurostat_download_dataset transfer, counted on the decoded TSV rather than on the wire. Eurostat sends the body chunked with no Content-Length, so the budget is enforced while streaming and the transfer is aborted when it is reached. Defaults to 50 MiB.

config.label: Set to 'duckdb' to enable the dataframe canvas, which lists the eurostat_dataframe_describe and eurostat_dataframe_query tools, lets eurostat_query_dataset stage a match larger than its 5,000-row inline cap as a SQL table, and lets eurostat_download_dataset retain a whole bulk download instead of only its inline preview
config.description: Set to 'duckdb' to enable the dataframe canvas, which lists the eurostat_dataframe_describe and eurostat_dataframe_query tools, lets eurostat_query_dataset stage a match larger than its 5,000-row inline cap as a SQL table, and lets eurostat_download_dataset retain a whole bulk download instead of only its inline preview. The DuckDB binding ships with the server, so this variable is the only switch.

config.label: Directory DuckDB writes canvas spill files to
config.description: Directory DuckDB writes canvas spill files to. Must be writable by the server process. Defaults to a 'mcp-canvas' directory under the OS temp directory.

config.label: Sliding lifetime of a staged dataframe canvas in milliseconds; every call against it extends the window
config.description: Sliding lifetime of a staged dataframe canvas in milliseconds; every call against it extends the window. Defaults to 24 hours.

config.label: Maximum rows a single eurostat_dataframe_query returns before the result is reported as truncated
config.description: Maximum rows a single eurostat_dataframe_query returns before the result is reported as truncated.
